scenario.suspicion_context: You are in the restricted area of the hospital without proper authorization and after visiting hours.
scenario.player_backstory: You claim to be visiting a patient but have no appointment scheduled and no clear identification.

clues.name: Two Ceramic Coffee Mugs
clues.description: Two mugs with faint coffee stains and a few fingerprints.
detail_points: Both mugs have DNA traces, but no complete match in the system.
One mug has a chip near the handle, possibly from a recent drop.
Made by a local pottery studio, marked 'The Clay Studio'.
clues.supports: Adds context to your presence but does not directly support or incriminate you.

clues.name: Hospital Phone With an Unread Message
clues.description: A hospital phone with a blinking light and an unread message.
detail_points: Message received at 10:15 PM from an unknown number.
Message content: 'Patient 45678 says you need to be questioned about their condition.'
Phone is registered to the hospital's administrative line.
clues.supports: Could be interpreted as an incriminating link if you have access to patient records.

clues.name: Maintenance Work Order
clues.description: A printed work order for repairs in the restricted wing.
detail_points: Authorised by Facilities Management on 14 April.
Requests repairs to Room 314, Sector C.
Approved by John Thompson, Facilities Manager.
clues.supports: Could support your claim of being here for maintenance, though no direct link to you.

clues.name: Appointment Confirmation Letter
clues.description: A letter confirming an appointment with the hospital.
detail_points: Appointment scheduled for 16 April at 2 PM.
clues.supports: Supports your claim of visiting a patient but does not directly connect to you.
